properties.title: Ukraine: single-signal dip, 36.8% (merit-nt)
properties.summary: Ukraine (UA): 36.8% connectivity drop (BGP -1.1%, active probing -1.3%, darknet -36.8%) over 1 h, against the same hours of the 7 days before. z-score -1.59 against the same 7 days. BGP held steady, so this reads as a single-source dip (BO-IND-4), not a confirmed outage. Other measurers in this country within 24 h: Cloudflare Radar 0 outages and 0 verified anomalies; NetBlocks 0 posts. Percent of normal: IODA active probing at 98.7% of its usual level for these hours. Exposure, an upper bound and not users affected: about 31 million people online in Ukraine (ITU 2024: 82.5% of 38 million). Access Now's STOP sheet lists 4 shutdowns here in 2025 (stated causes: conflict, other), the latest starting 2025-12-12; history only, not evidence about this outage.

properties.summary: Cloudflare Radar's route-leak detection lists 1 provider-customer-provider leak by this network since 2026-11-19T02:21:10Z, all finished; the largest carried 206 prefixes from 2 origin networks and was seen by 51 of Radar's 280 route-collector peers. Path (upstream > leaker > customer): AS12956 (TELEFONICA GLOBAL SOLUTIONS SL) > AS27986 > AS52468 (UFINET PANAMA S.A.). Event ID: 674740. A leak can send traffic the long way round or drop it; most are export mistakes (BO-H-4B). Reported by Cloudflare; Blackout does not assess intent.

properties.summary: Tuvalu (TV): 37.3% connectivity drop (BGP -37.3%) over 2 h 20 min, against the same hours of the 7 days before. active probing left out: its baseline median, 7.0, is under the floor of 20. OONI has 0 measurements from Tuvalu in the 3 hours from 00:00 UTC (about 0 on a usual day at those hours), too few to read blocking; late uploads can still add some. The drop alone doesn't tell a shutdown (BO-H-1A) from a power or physical fault (BO-H-1B). Other measurers in this country within 24 h: Cloudflare Radar 0 outages and 0 verified anomalies; NetBlocks 0 posts. Access Now's STOP sheet lists no shutdown in this country in 2025; context only, not evidence about this outage.
